highlight: Attention is the week's best seasoning.
nutrition_summary: This dinner week is comfort-forward by design: red sauce, burgers, pork, pasta, and pizza carry the joy. Let lunches and snacks do the balancing: fruit daily, yogurt or fortified milk for calcium and vitamin D, bean or lentil lunches twice, whole grains, crunchy vegetables, and a little extra omega-3 around Friday's branzino.
notes_additions: The week's through-line is contrast: cozy leftovers, crisp griddle nights, a Tuesday pasta ritual, bright lemon, and one sunny pizza table.
Keep the rhythm modular: prep what can wait patiently, let Elsie claim a real helper job, and save Friday for clean fish-and-greens brightness.

day_edits.day_intro: A cloudy 55° solo-parent Sunday calls for the kind of dinner that already knows the way home. Leftover gravy does the heavy lifting while the house settles into a quieter rhythm.
day_edits.dinner_description: Sunday gravy is Italian-American comfort at its best: tomato sauce deepened by meatballs, sausage, and time. Rigatoni makes the leftovers feel generous again, with pecorino and pasta water pulling everything glossy.
day_edits.dinner_notes: Warm the gravy low and slow; finish rigatoni in the pan with a splash of pasta water.
day_edits.album_description: The Strokes’ 2001 debut, produced by Gordon Raphael, still feels lean and immediate—clipped guitars, dry wit, downtown mini-scenes. It keeps a red-sauce night from getting too sleepy.
day_edits.album_pairing_rationale: Both dinner and record have old-neighborhood energy: familiar ingredients, sharp edges, no wasted motion.
day_edits.activity_notes: Set out bowls, dim the lights early, and let cleanup be tomorrow’s problem where possible.

day_edits.day_intro: Fog lifts into the warmest day of the week, but the late staff meeting leaves dinner needing speed. Pre-portioned wagyu turns the post-pickup window into a griddle sprint.
day_edits.dinner_description: Smash burgers work because cold beef meets fierce steel, building lacy browned edges before the center overcooks. Wagyu makes the richness bigger, so pickles, lettuce, and cold sauce need to stay loud.
day_edits.dinner_notes: Shape loose wagyu balls before the meeting; keep them cold until the griddle is smoking.
day_edits.album_description: Turnstile’s 2021 GLOW ON pushed hardcore into bright hooks, funk flashes, and festival-size release. It sounds communal without losing its snap.
day_edits.album_pairing_rationale: The record has the same rush as a smash burger: contact heat, crisp edges, and a grin.
day_edits.activity_notes: Give Elsie pickles, lettuce, sauce, and cheese control while the patties cook fast.

day_edits.day_intro: Light drizzle, swim lessons, and the on-call start make Tuesday feel crowded, so Babo Pasta needs a little advance staging. The reward is worth it: dinner becomes a family ritual instead of another rushed handoff.
day_edits.dinner_description: Egg-yolk spinach pasta is all silk, color, and family muscle memory. Brown butter and Parmigiano-Reggiano keep the sauce simple so the handmade noodles stay the point.
day_edits.dinner_notes: Stage flour, semolina, and tools before swim; brown the butter only when everyone is home.
day_edits.album_description: Little Simz's 2021 Sometimes I Might Be Introvert won the Mercury Prize by making private reflection feel orchestral and bold. It has the sweep of a film score and the intimacy of a journal.
day_edits.album_pairing_rationale: Babo Pasta rewards attention; Little Simz turns that same inward focus into something grand.
day_edits.activity_notes: Give Elsie one real job: crank, flour, noodle nest, or cheese grater.

day_edits.day_intro: By Wednesday, rain is steady, Laura is coming home, and Dan is still on call. The slow cooker earns its place by making pork chops tender before dinner asks for attention.
day_edits.dinner_description: Pork chops can go dry fast, so the gentle slow-cooked approach matters here. Mushrooms, thyme, Dijon, and cream turn the pan juices into a soft, savory sauce without any roasted red peppers muddying the flavor.
day_edits.dinner_notes: Sear chops and mushrooms first; cook on LOW and check early so tender does not become tired.
day_edits.album_description: Blood Orange’s 2013 Cupid Deluxe is Dev Hynes in city-night mode: synth-funk, R&B, and intimate songs about longing and belonging. It is sleek, but never cold.
day_edits.album_pairing_rationale: The mushroom cream sauce brings comfort; Blood Orange adds a rainy, graceful pulse.
day_edits.activity_notes: Keep the evening gentle: one shared table, one small travel story, early lights down.

day_edits.day_intro: Thursday stays drizzly and on-call, which makes stuffed cabbage feel like the right kind of patient dinner. It waits under sauce until the house is ready for something soft and steady.
day_edits.dinner_description: Stuffed cabbage rolls show up across Eastern European and Jewish kitchens because they are thrifty, tender, and built for feeding people well. This version leans sweet-savory, with cabbage leaves wrapping a plush beef-and-rice filling.
day_edits.dinner_notes: Assemble ahead if possible; reheat covered with extra sauce so the rolls stay moist.
day_edits.album_description: Billy Joel's 1977 The Stranger, produced by Phil Ramone, is full of booth-at-the-diner characters and piano hooks. It invites stories instead of disappearing into the background.
day_edits.album_pairing_rationale: Cabbage rolls and Billy Joel both feel like someone at the table has a story to tell.
day_edits.activity_notes: Serve in shallow bowls, keep cleanup light, and let the night land softly.

day_edits.day_intro: Friday is still a little damp, but the table can turn bright. Branzino, kale, lemon, and herbs give the week a clean finish before Saturday turns social.
day_edits.dinner_description: Branzino is a Mediterranean sea bass that loves whole roasting with olive oil, herbs, and decisive heat. Ladolemono, the Greek lemon-and-olive-oil sauce, ties the fish to garlicky kale and wakes up the plate.
day_edits.dinner_notes: Pat the fish very dry and whisk the ladolemono just before serving.
day_edits.album_description: Karol G's 2023 Mañana Será Bonito turns recovery into color, movement, and big melodic confidence. Its reggaeton-pop brightness keeps the drizzle from setting the tone.
day_edits.album_pairing_rationale: Lemon, herbs, and kale ask for lift; Karol G supplies sunshine without forcing cheer.
day_edits.activity_notes: Let Elsie season a small bite herself or help whisk the lemon sauce.

day_edits.day_intro: Sunny Saturday brings Patrick to the table, so dinner gets to be abundant and unfussy. Four pies keep the party moving without making one topping carry the whole night.
day_edits.dinner_description: Pizza night works best when each pie has a job: classic, pepperoni, spring asparagus white, and mushroom-fontina. Keeping roasted red peppers away from the mushroom pie lets each flavor stay clear.
day_edits.dinner_notes: Bake in waves and slice each pie before the next comes out so the table keeps circulating.
day_edits.album_description: Disclosure’s 2020 ENERGY is built from house momentum, global guests, and a title that tells the truth. It gives a visitor night lift without stealing the conversation.
day_edits.album_pairing_rationale: Four pizzas need motion; Disclosure keeps the kitchen buoyant and the table sociable.
day_edits.activity_notes: Make toppings modular, label the four pies, and let Patrick claim first slice.
